topic: Data gaps and sensor testing for bus shelters
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered data reporting requirements for missing data periods and potential sensor testing locations.

Regarding missing data, it was clarified that the only place where clients can see gaps is within the JCD dashboard. A team member confirmed that Guilamme is currently reprocessing the data using either an API or files uploaded to S3.

For bus shelters, a suggestion was made to add another test sensor location in a more crowded area to account for unusual behavior during lockdown periods.
decisions: The only place clients can see missing data is inside the JCD dashboard.
action_items: Follow up on adding an additional test sensor location for bus shelters in a more crowded area.
